title: Prescribed normalized CE row presentations
statement: For simultaneous prescribed augmented CE bicomplexes I,a on schemes X and bounded-below complexes K [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], assume individual lower bounds, quasi-isomorphic augmented rows, injective terms and horizontal cycles, boundaries and homology, and quasi-isomorphisms on their augmentations. There exist presentations P retaining I, positive-page differentials δ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential] and page isomorphisms j. Every transported successor comparison is normalized [lem-sp-filtered-complex-normalized-homology], and j inverse followed by firstPageIso equals the concrete signedRowComparison [def-weil-pbc-ce-canonical-row-comparison] followed by ceRowOrdinaryIso [lem-weil-pbc-ce-row-ordinary-naturality]. No scheme-map representative naturality is asserted.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homological Algebra
source.place: Tags 015J, 015K, 0130 and 012K; normalized CE pages and diagonal row representatives

proof.text: Obtain the second filtration and canonical abutment data from exists_hypercohomology_firstPage for the prescribed I,a and canonical K-injective resolution of K. Retain I,a and transport c and its finite image filtration through resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso. The augmentation and total comparison retain their summand formulas.

Construct the positive pages using their unique representative differentials and successor isomorphisms using their unique normalized homology comparisons. Adjoin the graded page zero via filteredComplex_graded_homology. Its first-page differential and negative-degree vanishing are the second-filtration row calculation.

Use the concrete signedRowComparison followed by the inverse row resolution isoRightDerivedObj as eDerived, and isoRightDerivedObj followed by ceRowOrdinaryIso as ordinaryComparison. Their inverse and hom cancel in firstPageIso. Coefficient naturality of the explicit ordinary comparison gives ordinary_naturality; the unsigned signed-row differential and right-derived naturality give dDerived. Assemble the structure fields and the identity positive-page comparisons j. All constructions use actual cokernels and extend-by-zero rows, including p=0, zero rows, negative q and empty diagonals.

theorem exists_etaleCE_normalized_row_presentations
    (I : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      HomologicalComplex₂ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ((CochainComplex.single₀
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
         (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ I X K)
    (hbelow : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero ((I X K).X s))
    (hrows : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ), QuasiIso ((a X K).f s))
    (hterms : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective (((I X K).X s).X r))
    (hhorizontal : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ),
      Injective (((I X K).cycles s).X r) ∧
      Injective ((image ((I X K).d (s - 1) s)).X r) ∧
      Injective (((I X K).homology s).X r))
    (hquasi : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ),
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (a X K) s) ∧
      QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' ((a X K).f (s - 1)) ((a X K).f s)
        ((a X K).comm (s - 1) s))) ∧
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a X K) s)) :
    ∃ (P : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (δ : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        FilteredComplexPageDifferential (P X K).sectionsTotal (P X K).L r)
      (j : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), (P X K).sequence.page r hr ≅ (δ X K r hr).page),
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        (P X K).I = I X K) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
        FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized (P X K).sectionsTotal (P X K).L r (δ X K r hr) pq
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}
            (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)) pq).mapIso (j X K r hr).symm ≪≫
            (P X K).sequence.iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr ≪≫
            (HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}
              (ComplexShape.up' (r + 1, 1 - (r + 1))) pq).mapIso
                (j X K (r + 1) (by omega)))) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        (j X K 1 (by omega)).inv.f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ ((P X K).firstPageIso p q).hom =
          ((P X K).signedRowComparison p q).hom ≫
            (ceRowOrdinaryIso X (K.obj.X q) (cePresentationRow (P X K) q) p).hom)
